programme.title: Joe Turner, Kenny Clarke, Don Byas & Art Simmons
programme.desc: This vintage program, ‘Jazz Marmalade', shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter ‘Big' Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907–1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life. From the American-owned Mars Club just off the Champs-Élysées, a hangout for showbiz people and expatriate Americans in Paris, the program cuts to the Blue Note. There, a Paris-based American quartet that includes drummer Kenny Clarke, organ player Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas performs ‘Salut Les Copines'. Returning to the Mars Club, the American jazz trio of house pianist Art Simmons (1926–2018) performs a jaunty take on ‘C-Jam Blues'. Rounding off the program at the Blue Note, the quartet of drummer Kenny Clarke, organist Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas returns for a swinging ‘April in Paris'. These recordings offer an invaluable glimpse into expatriate American jazz-making in Paris in the early 1960s.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr. combined his singing talent and infectious sense of humor as he covered songs from a variety of genres.

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan, Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris, Choeur de l'Opéra national de Paris & Ricarda Merbeth
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven's final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. He conducts the Orchestre and Choeurs de l'Opéra national de Paris and four vocal soloists Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Daniela Sindram (mezzosoprano), Robert Dean Smith (tenor), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Beethoven composed his last Symphony when his hearing had all but gone, between 1822 and 1824. Symphony No. 9 is the longest and most ambitious of Beethoven's symphonies. Most striking is the piece's finale movement, which includes a choir and four vocal soloists singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller's poem ‘An die Freude' (Ode to Joy). This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Raphael Pichon, Ensemble Pygmalion, Sabine Devieilhe & Arnaud de Pasquale
programme.sub-title: Mozart - A Gala for the Weber Sisters
programme.desc: On March 23, 1783, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart gave a successful concert at Vienna's Burgtheater that he dedicated to two sopranos: Aloysia and Josepha Weber, the sisters of his wife Constanze. The concert's program would be considered odd by today's standards. The composer's Symphony No. 35 was broken up and interspersed with other compositions, such as concertos, arias, and works for solo piano. Nearly two and a half centuries later, French soprano Sabine Devieilhe, conductor Raphaël Pichon and his Ensemble Pygmalion bring a wonderful concert inspired by that remarkable event. The program includes: ‘Allegro con spirito' of Symphony No. 35, also known as the Haffner Symphony ‘Vorrei spiegarvi, oh Dio', KV 418 ‘Schon lacht der holde Frühling', KV 580 Trio of ‘Die Schlittenfahrt' No. 3, KV 605 Deutscher Tanz No. 6, KV 571 ‘Der Hölle Rache kocht in meinem Herzen' from Mozart's opera Die Zauberflöte ‘Finale: Presto' of Symphony No. 35 ‘Nehmt meinen Dank', KV 383 and ‘Dans un bois solitaire et sombre', KV 308. This performance was recorded at Théâtre Impérial de Compiègne, in Compiègne, France.

programme.title: Antoine Tamistit & Robin Ticciati
programme.sub-title: Walton's Viola Concerto & Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton's Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in this Concerto. Brahms's Symphony No. 4 would be the composer's last – but every note burns with creative fire. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major, K. 216. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. With the exception of the first violin concerto, Mozart composed his other four violin concertos in 1775 at a time when he was concertmaster at the Salzburg court. Violin Concerto No. 3 opens with a theme the composer borrowed from the aria ‘Aer tranquillo' of his then recent opera Il re pastore. In the beautiful Adagio, the strings are muted and the oboes make way for the flutes, which only sound in the second movement. The finale movement has a dance-like character. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed his Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work around the same time as his Symphony No. 6, ‘Pastorale'. Both symphonies saw their premieres in a legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 5 has become one of the best-known compositions in western classical music. It opens with the famous four-note motif, often interpreted as the musical manifestation of 'fate knocking at the door'. This rhythmic figure returns in various guises in the other three movements of the symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Bastille
programme.desc: The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of annual music festivals that take place in Reading and Leeds, England. The events both happen on the bank holiday weekend in August (on Friday, Saturday, Sunday), and share the same bill (occasionally with one or two exceptions). The festival's origins date to the Beaulieu Jazz Festival (1956–1961) which became the National Jazz Festival in 1961 (The National Jazz and Blues Festival in 1963) and settled in Reading in 1971. In 1999 a second leg was added at Leeds. Featuring : Bastille.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: Milky Chance
programme.desc: The German duet is back and better than ever! Milky Chance is the success story of two school friends, Clemens Rehbein and Philipp Dausch. After a long break, 2017 marks the release of a second, long-waited, album "Blossom". And, for the public, finally the occasion to discover live these new compositions, mixing rock, folk and electro pop. With reggae vibrations that can rub shoulders with house elements, Milky Chance has one of the most singular sounds. With the presence of musicians on stage, and if we believe the listening of the new record, we can expect more electric concerts, more electronic and even more energetic than in the past!

programme.desc: (2006) Heart-pounding thriller with Charisma Carpenter. While investigating the sudden death of his best friend, a lawyer finds himself in love and in danger when he is seduced by a mysterious woman.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell, a daughter of wealthy British parents, has no interest in the social life of the London elite. Balls, receptions, and the British aristocracy bring her only boredom.

programme.title: Mary Shelley
programme.desc: The tempestuous romance that inspired one of Gothic literature's most influential works is brought to life in Mary Shelley, a luscious and moving period drama starring Elle Fanning and directed by Haifaa al-Mansour (Wadjda).

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Former CIA spy takes on his toughest assignment to date: looking after his girlfriend's three kids.

programme.title: Cooking with Love
programme.desc: Hardworking and optimistic television producer, Kelly, doesn't have time for love. Along with her mentor Amanda, Kelly dives into another season of the Little Gourmet, a kids cooking show, when hot-headed Chef Stephen is dropped into Kelly's life as a last minute replacement host. As the two struggle to make peace and a successful show, they realize they have a lot more in common than they thought - a love of food, the kids they encounter and each other.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: In this whimsical animated adventure, a mermaid princess makes a deal with a sea witch to transform into a human.

programme.title: My Name Is Nobody
programme.desc: Iconic, epic and Classic Western with Superstars Henry Fonda and Terence Hill.A young, easy-going gunman worships and competes with a famed gunfighter, insisting that he must face down a gang of 150 outlaws before he can retire.

programme.title: Somewhere in Time
programme.desc: A Chicago playwright uses self-hypnosis to journey back in time and meet the actress whose old portrait hangs in an elegant hotel.

programme.title: Hurricane Season
programme.desc: In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, high school basketball coach Al Collins assembles students from five different Louisiana schools and leads them all the way to the state championships.

programme.title: Prime
programme.desc: A career driven professional from Manhattan is wooed by a young painter, who also happens to be the son of her psychoanalyst.

programme.title: Zookeeper (2011)
programme.desc: The animals at one particular zoo decide to break their code of silence in order to help their lovable zookeeper gain the attention of one particular woman.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: When a wisecracking black hustler from South Central L.A. finds himself transported back to medieval England, he leads the overthrow of an evil king and wins the heart of a proto feminist woman.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: The officers work to find a bomber. But after catching him, they realize he has more targets set to explode.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy is attacked by an intruder at Traci's place and the Sex Crimes Unit steps in to take over the case.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy debates her future with Sam after learning the heart-breaking news that Marlo is pregnant with his baby.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: A riot breaks out at a women's prison while Andy, Juliet, Nick, and Gail are there to transfer prisoners.

programme.title: The Cookout
programme.desc: In an attempt at normality, the No. 1 NBA draft pick throws an old-fashioned neighborhood barbecue.

programme.title: The Devil You Know
programme.desc: A man has a chance to turn things around, but he finds himself spiraling back into the dark place he overcame.

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: A Single Man
programme.desc: An adaptation based on a novel by Christopher Isherwood, A Single Man is a romantic tale of love interrupted, the isolation that is an inherent part of the human condition, and ultimately the importance of the seemingly smaller moments in life. Set in Los Angeles in 1962, at the height of the Cuban missile crisis, A Single Man, tells the story of a British college professor (Colin Firth) who dwells on the past and cannot see his future. We follow him through a single day, where a series of events and encounters, ultimately leads him to decide if there is a meaning to life after the death of his long time partner, Jim (Matthew Goode, Watchmen).

programme.title: Henry V
programme.desc: King Henry V of England is insulted by the King of France. As a result, he leads his army into battle against France. Along the way, the young king must struggle with the sinking morale of his troops and his own inner doubts. The war culminates at the bloody Battle of Agincourt.

programme.title: King Arthur: Excalibur Rising
programme.desc: The story of King Arth-yr Ddantgwyn comes to an end in the 520AD, in the battle of Camlann. In the heat of battle, Arth-yr, with the legendary Excalibur, lands a fatal blow to his son Mordred, before receiving a deadly wound himself. Before succumbing to his wounds, he tasks his loyal knight Sir Bedivere with returning Excalibur, the source of Arth-yr's powers, to the Lady in the Lake.

programme.title: Pressure Point (PKA Heart of Champions)
programme.desc: Tough Army veteran, Coach Murphy (Shannon), arrives at the start of the new season to transform the status quo of a failing rowing team and unlock their true potential. With some tough love, can Coach Murphy inspire these young men to learn what it takes to be a team?

programme.title: Crossing the Line
programme.desc: From the team behind Oscar winners La La Land and Call Me by Your Name. This modern Western showcases breathtaking performances by Tessa Thompson and Lily James, who portray sisters forced into a life of crime to save their family. Faced with betrayal and violence, they risk everything on a drug smuggling mission. A brutally fresh look at all of Americas ills. Winters Bone meets Frozen River.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: For one family protecting their land on the Texas-Mexico border is everything but an encounter with an immigrant family leads to Jackson accidentally killing a boy. With his father Bill (Frank Grillo - Captain America: The Winter Soldier) attempting to take the blame, Jackson flees and crosses the border into Mexico. Now an illegal alien himself, he faces the very fears he imposed on others.

programme.title: Cold Brook
programme.desc: One fateful evening, after working late hours at the museum, two maintenance workers see a man standing silently near a Civil War exhibit. Despite chasing him away, each night he returns.

programme.title: Dating My Past
programme.desc: A couples therapy expert thinks back on what she's learned from her relationships with three exes: one with whom she can't deny the chemistry, one a sensitive artist, and one that's seemingly too perfect.

programme.title: Hamlet
programme.desc: Ian McKellen stars in the classic tale of revenge that has stood the test of time, reimagined for the modern day as a psychological thriller.

programme.title: The Martini Shot
programme.desc: This existential comedy follows an ailing movie director as he shoots what he believes to be his final work of art. What starts out as a normal movie, ends up being an exploration of mortality and one's profound effect on the world.

programme.title: Love Takes Flight
programme.desc: Single mum Lizzy has built boundaries at work and personal life to protect herself. After meeting an impulsive pilot, Charlie, at work, will she be open to change and open herself up to love? (2019)

programme.title: Holly Star
programme.desc: (2018) Quirky festive fun with Katlyn Carlson. Could a near-death experience and a vision of buried treasure fix a cash-strapped puppeteer's problems? Anything's possible at Christmas...

programme.title: The Movie Star and the Cowboy
programme.desc: (2022) Romance starring MacKenzie Porter and Toby Levins. Actress Isabella is desperate to land her dream role as a rancher - but will learning the ropes in Montana also land her a leading man?

programme.desc: (2022) Romance with Megan Elizabeth Barker. Lawyer Emma is promised a promotion if she can persuade Liam to sell his family's country lodge. But is she about to have a conflict of interest?

programme.desc: Two strangers who drunkenly got married in Vegas fight over a huge jackpot after having their annulment denied by a judge.

programme.title: Sincerely, Yours Truly
programme.desc: When Hayley finds a wedding ring with a letter hidden in a drawer in her new condo, she decides to write back… and the mysterious lover replies, starting a chain of letters and events that will change her life for ever!

programme.title: Bridal Fever
programme.desc: It's a literal race to the alter when a steamy romance novelist with a long line of torrid romances – and ex-husbands – sets out to help her editor, a single bachelorette, ditch her bridesmaid gowns once and for all in this romantic comedy.

programme.title: Love Wedding Marriage
programme.desc: A happy newlywed marriage counselor's views on wedded bliss get thrown for a loop when she finds out her parents are getting divorced. Starring: Mandy Moore, Kellan Lutz, James Brolin

programme.title: Finding Love in Big Sky
programme.desc: An independent country girl, Paisley, takes on the task of upholding her adored grandfather's ranch. After being denied the funding needed to refurbish the ranch, she is reintroduced to her ex-boyfriend Josh, a big-time marketing executive stationed in Denver who has been suspended from his current position at his company. Admitting to herself that she needs the help, Paisley agrees to work with Josh while he is town to come up with ideas on how to raise money for the farm.

programme.title: Lost in Love
programme.desc: Two tourists in Turkey get left behind by their tour bus after visiting an archaeological site. Without their belongings, they must make their way back to Istanbul, improvising along the way with meager means.

programme.title: Heaven Is Waiting
programme.desc: It has been years since Ned Stevens, a charming self-made success, lost his wife Kate to cancer. Yet he still can't let go of her memory and move forward with his life.. But when Liz brings home a new boyfriend from college -- Ned finds that his comfortable world is turned upside down as Liz tries to divert his attention to Carol, an attractive single woman who lives in Ned's neighborhood.

programme.title: Farm To Fork To Love
programme.desc: A young and talented chef, ALICE (Meggan Kaiser), works as a sous chef at one of the top restaurants in New York. After a disastrous night serving a food critic, she receives an invitation to judge a food competition in honor of the prestigious annual fundraiser for the St. Andrew's Children's Hospital. Alice accepts the invitation despite the dismay of BRETT, her boss who is also her boyfriend. Once she gets to Kansas, Alice is surprised to find her former boyfriend in college, CHRISTIAN (Scot cooper), is amongst the judges. The cooking show and her reconnection with Christian will make Alice reconsider her calling and make her dreams come true.

programme.title: All Aboard For Love
programme.desc: As Alison prepares for new ocean adventures, business executive Joel navigates his way into her heart and they become co-captains for life.

programme.title: The Wrong Cruise
programme.desc: Mother, daughter bond on cruise, fall for passengers, face trouble ashore.

programme.title: Toxic Love
programme.desc: Tales of toxic love triangles.

programme.title: Kidnapped in Paradise
programme.desc: Savannah brings her husband and daughter back to her birthplace in Australia.

programme.title: Vacation Home Nightmare
programme.desc: A woman is attacked in her rental and a shady Clean-Up Team steps in to help.

programme.title: Secrets in the Desert
programme.desc: Charlie and her boyfriend Aidan break down in the middle of nowhere.

programme.title: Mommy Would Never Hurt You
programme.desc: Riley wants to rebuild her bond with her mom and sick sister, but uncovers a secret that changes everything.

programme.title: Murder at the Mansion
programme.desc: As her wedding day approaches, a woman uncovers some deadly secrets hidden at her fiancé's lush family estate.

programme.title: His Secret Past
programme.desc: Popular crime novelist, Jennifer Becker lives a lavish life in a small coastal town in California with her daughter, Lily. One day, while out for a run, Lily is attacked--but then rescued by a mysterious stranger named Mick.

programme.title: Here Comes The Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher takes up fighting in mixed martial arts matches in order to raise money to save the music program at his school.

programme.title: Anger Management (2003)

programme.desc: Liz Gilbert (Julia Roberts) travels to discover meaning & happiness in this inspiring true story.

programme.title: The Heist

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2

programme.title: Bite Me

programme.title: Up the MacGregors

programme.title: Ramon the Mexican
programme.desc: Ramon avenges his brother's murder and kills the Baxter Family.

programme.title: Man with the Golden Pistol
programme.desc: Doc McGregor, former surgeon become player, is wrongly accused of murder and pursued by Slade, a bounty hunter.

programme.title: The Intelligence Men
programme.desc: Morecambe and Wise star in this tale of mystery and mayhem involving a spy racket.

programme.title: Don't Bother to Knock
programme.desc: A lively young travel agent's troubles begin when he mislays the key to his flat.

programme.title: Where There's a Will
programme.desc: Benjamin Stubbins is a penniless lawyer who has spent most of his money on drink.

programme.title: Ship That Died of Shame
programme.desc: Based on a short story by Nicholas Monsarrat and directed by Basil Dearden.

programme.title: Dagger of Death
programme.desc: India, 500 A.D.: A precious dagger is used in human sacrifices to goddess Kali. Sydney must return a relic to India for her fellow hunter, who believes the dagger made him kill his assistant.

programme.title: Last of the Mochicas

programme.title: Lost Contact
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel and billionaire entrepreneur Rod Thorson parachute into the Myanmar jungle to rescue a relic-hunting team hired by Thorson to locate an ancient sacrificial bowl.

programme.title: Cross of Voodoo
programme.desc: When two graduate students on the trail of the Haitian Cross of Utu disappear in New Orleans, Sydney and Nigel go down on the bayou to find them.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: The citizens of Spokane, a small town in Washington state, awaken to the sight of North Korean paratroopers dropping from the sky. The U.S.A. has been invaded and their hometown is the initial target. Without warning, the town is unable to fight back and finds itself under enemy occupation.

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: SURVIVOR is a gripping thriller about State Department employee Kate Abbott, newly posted in the American embassy in London. Kate is charged with stopping terrorists from getting into the U.S. which puts her directly in the line of fire.

programme.title: Enemy Within
programme.desc: When a Japanese fighter pilot crash-lands on the tiny remote Hawaiian island of Ni'ihau, he is met with courtesy and traditional Hawaiian hospitality from the locals.

programme.title: Samaritan
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Granite City's hometown hero, Samaritan, was reported dead after a fiery warehouse battle with his rival, Nemesis. Most in the city believe he perished in the fire, but one young boy holds out hope that Samaritan still lives!

programme.title: Blue Streak
programme.desc: Miles Logan (Martin Lawrence) is a talented jewel thief who has stolen $20 million dollars worth of diamonds and has hidden them at a construction site before being captured. Now, after three years in jail, he returns to pick up the diamonds only to find that the site is now a police precinct.

programme.title: Street Fighter (1994)
programme.desc: Based on the popular video game, a rogue military commander defies orders and battles one-on-one with the evil General Bison, a psychotic kidnapper holding 63 people hostage.

programme.title: Vantage Point
programme.desc: Seen from seven different perspectives, the President of the United States - who's really a body double of the prez - is shot during a speech in Madrid, while the real President (in a nearby hotel) is kidnapped by terrorists. Figuring out the terrorists' diversionary tactics and stunned by the betrayal of a fellow American agent, a skittish but brave Secret Service Agent tracks the terrorist leader to find the real president.

programme.title: Salt
programme.desc: Angelina Jolie stars in Columbia Pictures' Salt, a contemporary espionage thriller. Before becoming a CIA officer, Evelyn Salt (Jolie) swore an oath to duty, honor, and country. She will prove loyal to these when a defector accuses her of being a Russian sleeper spy. Salt goes on the run, using all her skills and years of experience as a covert operative to elude capture, protect her husband, and stay one step ahead of her colleagues at the CIA.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Alex Dee
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary big band leader and pianist Count Basie brought his famous big band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague to perform two sets. Basie, whose minimalist pianism and blues-oriented swing style had cemented his popularity as early as the 1930s, was in the midst of a European tour and had recorded his live album 'On the Road' the previous night in Montreux, Switzerland. Here is the second of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: John Patitucci, Marco Pignataro, Joe Lovano & Terri Lyne Carrington
programme.sub-title: The Tällberg Foundation: "Jazz for the Planet
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano). This recording, titled 'Tällberg's Jazz for the Planet', was made in support of the Tällberg Foundation's message and aims to inspire positive climate action. Since 1981, the Tällberg Foundation has been trying to nurture new thinking, in part by looking at societal challenges through the lenses of artists.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: John Lewis
programme.desc: Pianist John Lewis, co-founder and long-time leader of the legendary Modern Jazz Quartet, wrote jazz history with that band. His ability to blend classical forms with jazz improvisations singled him out as a unique artist, who was capable of transcending every musical barrier. When the Modern Jazz Quartet retired, John Lewis continued to work with other musicians and as a solo pianist. This program, recorded in studio conditions, features a spell-binding solo performance.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: The Monty Alexander Trio
programme.sub-title: Monty Alexander Quartet - Noth Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. On July 13, 1979, talented Jamaican pianist Monty Alexander was joined by Reggie Johnson (bass), Frank Gant (drums), Bobby Thomas (hand drum), and Othello Molineaux (steel drum) at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Alexander's Caribbean influences and natural flair for the piano shine through in this brilliant performance.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Joe Turner, Kenny Clarke, Don Byas & Art Simmons
programme.desc: This vintage program, ‘Jazz Marmalade', shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter ‘Big' Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907–1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life. From the American-owned Mars Club just off the Champs-Élysées, a hangout for showbiz people and expatriate Americans in Paris, the program cuts to the Blue Note. There, a Paris-based American quartet that includes drummer Kenny Clarke, organ player Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas performs ‘Salut Les Copines'. Returning to the Mars Club, the American jazz trio of house pianist Art Simmons (1926–2018) performs a jaunty take on ‘C-Jam Blues'. Rounding off the program at the Blue Note, the quartet of drummer Kenny Clarke, organist Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas returns for a swinging ‘April in Paris'. These recordings offer an invaluable glimpse into expatriate American jazz-making in Paris in the early 1960s.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr. combined his singing talent and infectious sense of humor as he covered songs from a variety of genres.

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan, Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris, Choeur de l'Opéra national de Paris & Ricarda Merbeth
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven's final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. He conducts the Orchestre and Choeurs de l'Opéra national de Paris and four vocal soloists Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Daniela Sindram (mezzosoprano), Robert Dean Smith (tenor), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Beethoven composed his last Symphony when his hearing had all but gone, between 1822 and 1824. Symphony No. 9 is the longest and most ambitious of Beethoven's symphonies. Most striking is the piece's finale movement, which includes a choir and four vocal soloists singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller's poem ‘An die Freude' (Ode to Joy). This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Raphael Pichon, Ensemble Pygmalion, Sabine Devieilhe & Arnaud de Pasquale
programme.sub-title: Mozart - A Gala for the Weber Sisters
programme.desc: On March 23, 1783, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart gave a successful concert at Vienna's Burgtheater that he dedicated to two sopranos: Aloysia and Josepha Weber, the sisters of his wife Constanze. The concert's program would be considered odd by today's standards. The composer's Symphony No. 35 was broken up and interspersed with other compositions, such as concertos, arias, and works for solo piano. Nearly two and a half centuries later, French soprano Sabine Devieilhe, conductor Raphaël Pichon and his Ensemble Pygmalion bring a wonderful concert inspired by that remarkable event. The program includes: ‘Allegro con spirito' of Symphony No. 35, also known as the Haffner Symphony ‘Vorrei spiegarvi, oh Dio', KV 418 ‘Schon lacht der holde Frühling', KV 580 Trio of ‘Die Schlittenfahrt' No. 3, KV 605 Deutscher Tanz No. 6, KV 571 ‘Der Hölle Rache kocht in meinem Herzen' from Mozart's opera Die Zauberflöte ‘Finale: Presto' of Symphony No. 35 ‘Nehmt meinen Dank', KV 383 and ‘Dans un bois solitaire et sombre', KV 308. This performance was recorded at Théâtre Impérial de Compiègne, in Compiègne, France.

programme.title: Antoine Tamistit & Robin Ticciati
programme.sub-title: Walton's Viola Concerto & Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton's Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in this Concerto. Brahms's Symphony No. 4 would be the composer's last – but every note burns with creative fire. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major, K. 216. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. With the exception of the first violin concerto, Mozart composed his other four violin concertos in 1775 at a time when he was concertmaster at the Salzburg court. Violin Concerto No. 3 opens with a theme the composer borrowed from the aria ‘Aer tranquillo' of his then recent opera Il re pastore. In the beautiful Adagio, the strings are muted and the oboes make way for the flutes, which only sound in the second movement. The finale movement has a dance-like character. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed his Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work around the same time as his Symphony No. 6, ‘Pastorale'. Both symphonies saw their premieres in a legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 5 has become one of the best-known compositions in western classical music. It opens with the famous four-note motif, often interpreted as the musical manifestation of 'fate knocking at the door'. This rhythmic figure returns in various guises in the other three movements of the symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Beck
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Beck performs his hits including "Loser", "Wave", "Debra" and many more.

programme.title: Bastille
programme.desc: The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of annual music festivals that take place in Reading and Leeds, England. The events both happen on the bank holiday weekend in August (on Friday, Saturday, Sunday), and share the same bill (occasionally with one or two exceptions). The festival's origins date to the Beaulieu Jazz Festival (1956–1961) which became the National Jazz Festival in 1961 (The National Jazz and Blues Festival in 1963) and settled in Reading in 1971. In 1999 a second leg was added at Leeds. Featuring : Bastille.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: Milky Chance
programme.desc: The German duet is back and better than ever! Milky Chance is the success story of two school friends, Clemens Rehbein and Philipp Dausch. After a long break, 2017 marks the release of a second, long-waited, album "Blossom". And, for the public, finally the occasion to discover live these new compositions, mixing rock, folk and electro pop. With reggae vibrations that can rub shoulders with house elements, Milky Chance has one of the most singular sounds. With the presence of musicians on stage, and if we believe the listening of the new record, we can expect more electric concerts, more electronic and even more energetic than in the past!

programme.title: Mahler. Una sombra en el pasado
programme.desc: Gustav Mahler fue un eminente compositor y director de orquesta. De origen judío, desde muy niño soportó el antisemitismo. Tuvo una salud precaria y una neurosis obsesiva por la muerte. Ya mayor se casó con una mujer joven, culta y muy bella, teniendo un matrimonio apasionado y lleno de conflictos.

programme.title: Orfeo
programme.desc: Ambientación del mito griego en el carnaval de Río de Janeiro. La bella Eurídice visita la ciudad brasileña en vísperas de su famoso carnaval, invitada por una prima que vive en los arrabales. Hasta allí llega en un tranvía cuyo conductor, un guitarrista llamado Orfeo, queda prendado de sus encantos. Sin embargo su relación se verá empañada por las sospechas de su celosa novia.

programme.title: El hombre del brazo de oro
programme.desc: Frankie Machine, un hombre con talento musical sale de la cárcel y, además, consigue dejar la heroína. Su principal problema será encontrar un medio de vida honrado y evitar las drogas y el juego.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Siguiendo los pasos del éxito de "Paris, je t'aime" doce directores y varios actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York como set y narran diferentes historias de amor.

programme.title: Melancolía
programme.desc: Con motivo de su matrimonio, Justine y Michael dan una suntuosa recepción en la casa de la hermana de Justine y de su cuñado. Mientras tanto, el planeta Melancholia se dirige hacia la Tierra.

programme.title: Siempre Alice
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Julianne Moore), 2014. La doctora Alice Howland es una profesora casada y madre de 3 hijos, no da importancia a los pequeños lapsus hasta que debe comenzar a luchar para seguir siendo Alice.

programme.title: Verano
programme.desc: Fragmentos de un día de verano.

programme.title: Ya te extraño
programme.desc: Amistad femenina enfrenta cáncer y embarazo.

programme.title: Oficina Zombie
programme.desc: Un empleado de una fábrica descubre que una bebida energética convierte a sus compañeros en zombis.

programme.title: Un Hombre Solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo venido a menos intenta superar tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera.

programme.title: El Barón Rojo
programme.desc: Película biográfica que narra partes de la vida del mítico as de la aviación de la Primera Guerra Mundial Manfred von Richthofen, cuya habilidad y hazañas le llevó a convertirse en una leyenda durante esa contienda, temido por sus adversarios.

programme.title: The Square
programme.desc: Christian es un padre divorciado que disfruta dedicando su tiempo a sus dos hijas, es un valorado programador de un museo de arte contemporáneo y es de esa clase de personas que conducen un coche eléctrico y respaldan las grandes causas humanitarias.

programme.title: Deseando amar
programme.desc: Dos vecinos forman un fuerte vínculo después de que ambos sospechen de actividades extramatrimoniales de sus cónyuges. Sin embargo, acuerdan mantener su vínculo platónico para no cometer errores similares.

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: 70 años después de una guerra entre seres humanos y extraterrestres que casi acaba con la raza humana, un niño prodigio es enviado a una escuela militar espacial con el fin de prepararlo para una futura invasión. Ese niño se llama Ender y él no lo sabe, pero es el único que puede evitar la invasión.

programme.title: La promesa
programme.desc: Años 20, durante los últimos días del Imperio Otomano. Michael (Oscar Isaac), un brillante estudiante de medicina, y Chris (Christian Bale), un prestigioso periodista americano, se enamoran de la misma mujer, la bella y sofisticada Ana, en medio del brutal genocidio armenio de 1915.

programme.title: La Directora de orquesta
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales. Cuenta la historia de Antonia Brico, una joven que sueña en convertirse en directora de orquesta, pero nadie la toma en serio por ser una mujer.

programme.title: Big Eyes
programme.desc: 'Big Eyes' está basada en la historia real de Walter Keane, uno de los pintores más exitosos de los años 50. El artista alcanzó una notoriedad asombrosa con sus enigmáticas pinturas de niños abandonados con grandes ojos. La autora era Margaret, su mujer, pero en realidad los firmaba Walter.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Claude, un hombre viudo de unos setenta años, que vive solo y está desencantado con su única hija, se entera un día de que LILLIAN, la mujer que fue el el primer amor de su vida tiene Alzheimer y está ingresada en una residencia especializada.

programme.title: Mi segunda vez
programme.desc: La ganadora de un Oscar Catherine Zeta-Jones (“Chicago”) da vida a una mujer que, tras descubrir que su marido la engaña, se va a Nueva York y allí se enamora de un joven que le hará descubrir que las segundas oportunidades existen.

programme.title: El velo pintado
programme.desc: Walter y Kitty son una pareja de ingleses que deciden casarse por motivos equivocados y se establecen en Shanghai. En esta exótica ciudad, ella se enamora de otro hombre.

programme.title: Un trabajo embarazoso
programme.desc: Thea, una joven ejecutiva, finge estar embarazada para evitar que su empresa la despida. Cuando todo el mundo multiplica sus atenciones hacia ella y empieza a recibir cada vez más ayuda, no le queda otra salida que mantener la mentira durante nueve meses.

programme.title: 20 años no importan
programme.desc: Alice Lantins tiene 38 años. Es guapa, ambiciosa y da muestras de una profesionalidad impecable, hasta el punto de olvidar su vida privada.

programme.title: Buffalo Soldiers
programme.desc: 1989. El muro de Berlín está a punto de caer y el planeta va a convertirse en un lugar seguro según un nuevo orden mundial. El especialista Ray Elwood, en la Base del ejército norteamericano, está a punto de comprobar cómo su particular guerra fría se pone al rojo vivo. Elwood, bastante granuja, atiendo su trabajo como secretario del oficial superior. Cuando llega a la base un nuevo Sargento Primero, éste se dedicará a limpiarla de arriba abajo. Para mayor complicación, Elwood le echa el ojo a la hija del Sargento.

programme.title: El joven Karl Marx
programme.desc: En el París de 1844, tras exiliarse con su mujer, Karl Marx conoce a Friedrich Engels, quien investiga el nacimiento de la clase obrera británica.

programme.title: Los bicivoladores
programme.desc: Tres jóvenes tienen el bicicross como afición. Un día, tras un accidente sus bicicletas quedan destrozadas. Para sacar dinero se les ocurre pescar almejas y encuentran un paquete que les traerá problemas...

programme.title: Igelak
programme.desc: Pello decide huir y cambiar de identidad, pero acaba viviendo en un edificio okupa.

programme.title: La Guerra de Los Abuelos
programme.desc: Gerri vive con su hija y cuida a sus nietos, hasta que el abuelo Tom regresa de Italia y rompe la calma.

programme.title: El Forastero
programme.desc: El forastero procede de un planeta arrasado por el desorden medioambiental y la lluvia radiactiva.

programme.title: Todo Por La Taquilla
programme.desc: César, Alfredo, David y Manuel se reencuentran después de años en el velatorio de un amigo.

programme.title: Un padre de cuidado
programme.desc: Tim Allen es Joe, un chico cuya vida ha ido constantemente cambiando para peor. Cuando el acosador de la oficina va demasiado lejos, Joe decide que es hora volverse a sí mismo de un don nadie en un alguien.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Con 2 nominaciones a los Globos de Oro y con un trío cómico protagonista impecable, 'St. Vincent' cuenta la historia de un chico cuyos padres se acaban de divorciar. La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos idénticos (interpretados por Edward Norton) dan un giro cuando el primero, un profesor de filosofía, es confundido por el segundo, un traficante de drogas al que varios clanes del narcotráfico quieren ver muerto.

programme.title: Con la magia en los zapatos
programme.desc: Max Simkin (Adam Sandler) repara zapatos en una tienda neoyorquina perteneciente a su familia. Desencantado con su rutina diaria, Max tropieza con una reliquia familiar que le permite ser testigo de la vida de sus clientes a través de los zapatos que repara y ver el mundo de una forma nueva.

programme.title: El club de las madres solteras
programme.desc: Cuando cinco madres solteras luchadoras apartan sus diferencias para formar un grupo de apoyo, encuentran la inspiración y la risa en su nueva hermandad, y se ayudan unas a otras a superar los obstáculos a los que se enfrentan.

programme.title: El Romance De Murphy
programme.desc: Lo último que Emma Moriarty (Sally Field) esperaba encontrar en Eunice, Arizona, era el amor. Pero cuando ella y su hijo (Corey Haim) se mudan a la ciudad, repentinamente descubre que es objeto de las atenciones de Murphy Jones (Garner) .

programme.title: Ese Poli Es Un Panoli
programme.desc: Las cosas no salen como se planearon cuando un detective implacable planea una vigilancia en la casa de los Robbersons, junto a la cual está la de un matón de la mafia.

programme.title: Locos De Remate
programme.desc: Richard Pryor y Gene Wilder protagonizan en una desopilante comedia sobre dos convictos que intentan por todos los medios de escapar de la cárcel.

programme.title: Superpoli De Centro Comercial
programme.desc: Paul Blart es un padre soltero del extrarradio. Intenta ganarse la vida como guardia de seguridad en un gran centro comercial de Nueva Jersey. A pesar de que nadie toma su trabajo en serio, Paul considera que está al frente de la seguridad del recinto. Cuando un atraco cierra las puertas del centro comercial, el oficial de seguridad más extraordinario de Jersey tendrá que convertirse en un policía de verdad para poder salvar la situación.

programme.title: La leyenda del Llanero Solitario
programme.desc: El único Ranger de Texas (Klinton Spilsbury) superviviente de una emboscada organizada por el líder de los forajidos, el Mayor Bartholomew "Butch" Cavendish (Christopher Lloyd), vuelve para contraatacar como un gran héroe del western enmascarado, El Llanero Solitario.

programme.title: Cassidy Red
programme.desc: Cassidy regresa a su pueblo natal del Viejo Oeste buscando vengar a su amante asesinado por su exprometido, un agente de la ley corrupto. Dividida entre amor, odio y justicia, su búsqueda se convierte en una batalla feroz por redención y verdad.

programme.title: Juan Moreira
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, el arriero Juan Moreira es un buen gaucho y trabajador que, como muchos otros, es objeto de abusos y humillaciones por parte de los poderosos: los terratenientes de la policía.

programme.title: Campanas de Coronado
programme.desc: Roy es un investigador de seguros que investiga el robo de mineral de uranio. Debe evitar que los ladrones despeguen en un avión con el mineral robado.

programme.title: Doc West
programme.desc: El legendario jugador de póquer Triggerman llega a un torneo donde las apuestas son altas y los bandidos juegan sucio. Pronto, las trampas y las balas vuelan, convirtiendo el juego en un duelo a vida o muerte. Con su habilidad y su revólver, Triggerman no dejará que nadie lo aparte de la victoria.

programme.title: El pirata
programme.desc: El pirata griego reconvertido en hombre de negocios Ioannis Varvakis hizo fortuna vendiendo caviar en Rusia y en todo el mundo. Varvakis lucha toda su vida por la libertad para sí mismo y luego para su país.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente
programme.desc: Un agente secreto altamente clasificado del presidente de Estados Unidos debe encontrar a un intrépido sustituto que se haga cargo de sus peligrosísimas misiones militares.

programme.title: El candidato
programme.desc: En un estado rural, un hombre de negocios es moldeado por un equipo de campaña para crearle una imagen que lo haga aceptable a los votantes de clase media.

programme.title: En primera línea
programme.desc: Un equipo de bomberos del Ejército de Estados Unidos está fracturado por tensiones raciales, crisis morales y las presiones del combate en una guerra que nadie quiere pelear.

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: La esposa de Desmond lo abandona a él y a sus tres hijos después de la Navidad de 1953. Desempleado en Dublín, las autoridades colocan a los niños en orfanatos. Al volver a trabajar, Desmond intenta recuperar a sus hijos.

programme.title: Testigo virtual
programme.desc: Thomas asiste en directo desde su web al asesinato de Cathy. Al querer llamar a la policía se dá cuenta de que no tiene ni su nombre ni su dirección a pesar de llevar varios meses chateando con ella. Thomas se ve implicado en la investigación que realiza Claire, una joven especialista de la delincuencia informática. Las indagaciones les conducen hasta el hermano de Thomas que al parecer tiene relación con una organización criminal que actúa en directo por Internet. Pero a Claire le retiran el asunto de la noche a la mañana. Entonces, ella y Thomas deciden colocar una trampa con la que esperan revelar toda la verdad.

programme.title: La doble
programme.desc: Una estrella de cine, que no paga los impuestos, decide contratar a una doble para que haga todos los trabajos comunitarios por ella.

programme.title: El regreso de Aladino
programme.desc: Después de liberar a Bagdad de las garras de su terrible visir, Aladin está aburrido en palacio. Todavía no ha decidido pedir matrimonio a la princesa. Pero un terrible dictador, Shah Zaman, se invita al Palacio y anuncia que ha venido a tomar la ciudad y casarse con la Princesa. Aladin no tiene más remedio que huir del Palacio. Intentará recuperar a su antiguo Genio y así, volver para liberar a la ciudad y salvar a su novia.

programme.title: Cuando cae la nieve
programme.desc: 1950, Moscú. La comunista Katya (Rebecca Ferguson) es una espía del gobierno americano en plena carrera armamentística de la Guerra Fría. Cuando le asignan su misión más importante, conseguir información secreta de la joven promesa del gobierno ruso, Alexander (Sam Reid, Charles Dance), lo último que espera es que va a enamorarse de él. Intentar conciliar su pasión hacia a él con su rechazo al comunismo la llevará a hacer el mayor de los sacrificios, un gesto que Alexander descubrirá treinta años más tarde.

programme.title: La abeja Maya. La película
programme.desc: La curiosa abeja Maya y su amigo Willy salvarán a la colmena de la avaricia del consejero de la reina y pondrán fin a años de hostilidad entre abejas y avispas. Maya es una abeja recién nacida muy vivaracha que no sigue las reglas de la colmena, entre ellas la de no confiar en las avispas que viven más allá de la pradera. Cuando desaparece la jalea real, las avispas son las principales sospechosas y las abejas señalan a Maya como cómplice del robo. Ninguna de sus compañeras cree en su inocencia y Willy, su mejor amigo, será su único apoyo. Juntos se embarcarán en un largo viaje lleno de aventuras hasta la colmena de las avispas para encontrar al verdadero culpable. Gracias a Maya y Willy por fin reinará la amistad entre todos los residentes de la opulenta pradera.

programme.title: Anita no pierde el tren
programme.desc: Anita ve como derriban el cine en el que trabaja como taquillera. A partir de ese día su vida cambia.

programme.title: Re-emigrantes
programme.desc: Los Briones deciden regresar a su pueblo de origen, Villanueva de los Molinos, Una vez allí, Santiago, y sus hijos tratarán de adaptarse a su nueva vida realizando todo tipo de trabajos.

programme.title: Año de Gracia
programme.desc: Gràcia es una mujer de sesenta y pico años que vive sola y se siente muy abandonada. La pesada soledad le acerca hasta David, un joven estudiante de veinte años a quien ofrece una habitación en su casa a cambio de algo que no tiene y que le hace mucha falta.

programme.title: La Mujer sin Piano
programme.desc: Un ama de casa casada para la que no hay nada comparable a la íntima satisfacción de ver el plato humeante servido con admirable puntualidad a la hora de la comida. Veinticuatro horas de su vida de la que una noche decide escapar, y cuenta todo lo que le pasa en esta fuga.

programme.title: Benidorm mon amour
programme.desc: Tonet aprovecha un permiso de la mili para ir en coche con sus amigos Sento, Jaume y Tomy a Benidorm. Sueñan con disfrutar unos días del sol, las playas y, sobre todo, de las suecas y sus biquinis.

programme.title: Chocolate Strawberry Vanilla
programme.desc: Awkward, lonely ice-cream truck driver Warren Thompson has two major problems: an unhealthy obsession with a soap opera actress, and a gang of bullies who like to savagely beat him on a regular basis. As Warren slowly slips out of reality and into a psychotic fantasy world to escape his miserable life, a darker, deadlier Warren emerges to deal with his problems and put an end to his tormentors.

programme.title: Strange Illusion
programme.desc: A teenage boy suspects that the man who is wooing his widowed mother has ulterior motives.

programme.title: Experiment
programme.desc: A man and woman walk the streets of a foreign city with no memory of who they are and plagued by nightmarish visions. Unknown to them their every action is being guided by unseen forces from the dark underground shadows of the city.

programme.title: Cub
programme.desc: A camping trip turns into a carnage for a troop of cub scouts as a killer stalks them with deadly traps.

programme.title: Behewulf: la Leyenda Vikinga
programme.desc: Dinamarca, siglo VI. El rey danés Hrothgar y sus guerreros matan a un trol cuyo hijo, Grendel, jura vengarse.

programme.title: Kung Fu Killer 1
programme.desc: Un monje caucásico de Shanghai se infiltra en los bajos fondos para encontrar a los asesinos de su Gran Maestro espiritual femenino.

programme.title: La espada del asesino
programme.desc: Nguyen Vu es el único sobreviviente de su familia que fue ejecutada por la emperatriz de Vietnam. Descubre que tal atrocidad fue motivada tras ser acusados por delitos que no cometieron y se propone hacer justicia y limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: Gun shy
programme.desc: La historia sigue a Turk Henry (Antonio Banderas), una superestrella del rock con discos de platino, casado con una supermodelo (Olga Kurylenko) y más rico de lo que jamás soñó. Durante unas vacaciones, su esposa es misteriosamente secuestrada por un grupo de piratas renegados sin barco. Con poca ayuda de las autoridades locales, Turk se ve obligado a embarcarse en una misión para rescatarla. Con habilidades más aptas para tocar el bajo, ligar y salir de fiesta, tendrá que enfrentarse a peligrosas selvas y a despiadados bandidos en esta divertida y trepidante aventura llena de acción.

programme.title: Ace Bodyguard
programme.desc: Esta película cuenta la historia de Zhang Han, un guardaespaldas de élite «retirado», que une fuerzas con su antiguo compañero para rescatar a su esposa secuestrada.

programme.title: Espacio/Tiempo
programme.desc: En un futuro al borde del colapso, unos científicos desarrollan una turbina para realizar viajes interestelares que podría salvar a la humanidad. Cuando les cortan la financiación por un fatal accidente, deciden recurrir a actividades delictivas para reconstruir su máquina.

programme.title: La particula de Dios
programme.desc: El detective privado Ned Cruz recibe el encargo de encontrar a Lexi Persimmon, una stripper que ha desaparecido junto a un alijo de diamantes valorado en 30 millones de dólares. Cruz topará con personajes oscuros, algunos morirán misteriosamente, otros tienen entre manos planes siniestros.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente I
programme.desc: Joshua McCord es un agente del servicio secreto retirado al que le encargan la misión de entrenar a un joven. Sin embargo, cuando la Primera Dama es secuestrada por terroristas, se encuentra inmerso en una misión de 'todo o nada'.

programme.title: La fiebre de la pradera
programme.desc: Para algunos, el Oeste es un lugar de oportunidades y aventuras. Para otros, es tierra de muerte y peligros.

programme.title: Jackie Chan: Maestro en Kung Fu
programme.desc: Jackie Chan es el invicto Maestro de Kung Fu que reparte acción al estilo tradicional de Jackie Chan. Cuando un joven se dispone a aprender a luchar del mismísimo Maestro, no sólo es testigo de espectaculares combates, sino que aprende importantes lecciones de vida por el camino.

programme.title: Desierto de Fuego
programme.desc: Laura es secuestrada al investigar un desastre ecológico mientras un volcán amenaza con erupcionar.

programme.title: El almirante: Mar de fuego
programme.desc: En 1597, Yi Sun-Shin lidera 12 barcos contra más de 300 navíos japoneses en una batalla histórica.

programme.title: Tentáculos de Las Bermudas
programme.desc: Cuando el Air Force One se estrella, la Marina envía a su mejor equipo de rescate.

programme.title: Sharknado
programme.desc: Cuando un extraño huracán azota Los Ángeles, miles de tiburones aterrorizan a la población inundada.

programme.title: Ultravioleta
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XXI, surge una subcultura de seres humanos con una mutación genética: están dotados de una asombrosa velocidad, una increíble resistencia y una profunda inteligencia. A medida que hay más personas contagiadas, el temor del gobierno aumenta y a los mutantes se les trata como a marginados, se les somete a pruebas espantosas y se les pone en cuarentena. El gobierno ha tomado la determinación de acabar con ellos, pero una mujer está decidida a impedirlo: la ultrabella y ultraletal Violet. Gracias a sus impresionantes técnicas de artes marciales y a su capacidad camaleónica, Violet se convierte en una guerrera solitaria dedicada a proteger a su nueva raza y a vengarse de los que la crearon.

programme.title: Life: Vida
programme.desc: LIFE: VIDA es un aterrador thriller de ciencia ficción sobre un grupo de científicos a bordo de la Estación Espacial Internacional, cuya misión de reconocimiento acaba sumida en el pánico cuando descubren una forma de vida extraterrestre que evoluciona rápidamente y que ha causado la extinción en Marte. Ahora, amenaza a la tripulación y a toda la vida sobre la Tierra.

programme.title: Jóvenes Y Brujas
programme.desc: Sarah siempre fue diferente. Y como la chica nueva en St. Benedict's Academy, inmediatamente se junta con las marginadas del instituto. Pero estas chicas no se conformarán con ser unas inadaptadas sin poder. Han descubierto “"THE CRAFT", y van a usarlo.

programme.title: District 9
programme.desc: Del productor Peter Jackson y el director Neill Blomkamp surge un asombrosamente original thriller de ciencia ficción que en el que se envía a un grupo de refugiados alienígenas, varados en la Tierra a un barrio bajo a las afueras de Johannesburgo.
